text: The Museum purchased a bronze statue of Mantiklos 'Apollo' using funds from the Francis Bartlett Donation of 1900.
source_sentence: Museum purchase with funds from the Francis Bartlett Donation of 1900.

text: The second phase of construction built a wing along The Fens to house painting galleries, funded entirely by Maria Antoinette Evans Hunt, and opened in 1915.
source_sentence: The second phase of construction built a wing along The Fens to house painting galleries. It was funded entirely by Maria Antoinette Evans Hunt, the wife of wealthy business magnate Robert Dawson Evans, and opened in 1915.

text: The Loïs Mailou Jones Pierre-Noël Trust gifted the artwork 'Negro Student' created in 1934.
source_sentence: Gift of the Loïs Mailou Jones Pierre-Noël Trust.

text: The unparalleled Wan-go H. C. Weng Collection of Ming and Qing paintings and calligraphy was gifted to the MFA in 2018.
source_sentence: The already strong collection of Song and Yuan dynasty paintings was in 2018 expanded dramatically by the gift of the unparalleled Wan-go H. C. Weng Collection of Ming and Qing paintings and calligraphy.

text: John Goelet donated a work titled 'Maharana Sangram Singh Enjoys the Monsoon', an Indian Rajasthani opaque watercolor on paper.
source_sentence: Unknown artist, Maharana Sangram Singh Enjoys the Monsoon (detail), Indian, Rajasthani, about 1720–25. Opaque watercolor on paper. Gift of John Goelet.

text: The Museum purchased a marble statue of Juno with funds donated by George D. and Margo Behrakis.

text: The Museum purchased a sarcophagus or large urn with cover using funds from the Francis Bartlett Donation of 1912.
source_sentence: Museum purchase with funds from the Francis Bartlett Donation of 1912.

text: The Museum of Fine Arts was founded in 1870 and was initially located on the top floor of the Boston Athenæum.

text: In 2010, the new Art of the Americas Wing opened with free admission to the public.
source_sentence: The wing opened on November 20, 2010, with free admission to the public.

text: In November 2020, a significant number of MFA employees voted to unionize due to a long history of unaddressed issues related to workplace conditions and compensation inequities.
source_sentence: In November 2020 a significant number of MFA employees voted to unionize due to a long history of unaddressed issues related to workplace conditions and compensation inequities.

text: MFA staff went on a strike for the first time on November 17, 2021, citing unresponsive engagement from MFA management over multiple issues.
source_sentence: After over 96% of the union agreed in a vote, MFA staff went on a strike for the first time on November 17, 2021.

text: The 12,000-square-foot glass-enclosed courtyard features a 42.5-foot high glass sculpture, titled the Lime Green Icicle Tower, by Dale Chihuly.
source_sentence: The 12,000-square-foot (1,100 m2) glass-enclosed courtyard now features a 42.5-foot (13.0 m) high glass sculpture, titled the Lime Green Icicle Tower, by Dale Chihuly.

text: W. G. Russell Allen bequeathed the lithograph 'Woman Seated in a Loge' around 1880.
source_sentence: Bequest of W. G. Russell Allen.

text: Ruth S. Pollen bequeathed the etching 'Self-Portrait with Saskia' created in 1636.
More than 13,500 visitors attended the opening of the Art of the Americas Wing.
source_sentence: Mayor Thomas Menino declared it 'Museum of Fine Arts Day', and more than 13,500 visitors attended the opening.

text: Forsyth Wickes donated the artwork titled 'Laughing Man' as part of The Forsyth Wickes Collection.
source_sentence: Bequest of Forsyth Wickes—The Forsyth Wickes Collection.

text: The museum moved to its current Fenway location in 1909.
source_sentence: The museum moved to its current Fenway location in 1909.
